gloss: short period of time; brief span

definitions.gloss: short period of time; brief span; short term
definitions.explanation: A relatively brief duration. Often used adverbially with で (in a short period) to describe how quickly something was accomplished.

examples.japanese: {短期間|たんきかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上達|じょうたつ}した→上達する：17981_joutatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: My Japanese improved in a short period of time.

examples.japanese: {短期間|たんきかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧もの⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Even a short study-abroad period yields many benefits.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{短期間|たんきかん}のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{急成長|きゅうせいちょう}→急成長：15841_kyuuseichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げた→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧。
examples.english: That company achieved rapid growth in a short period of time.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with で (in), ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (of), or のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (within) to express that something happened in a short time frame. Frequently appears in business, education, and news contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短期間|たんきかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in a short period)
- {短期間|たんきかん}のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (within a short period)
- {短期間|たんきかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}→集中：03212_shuuchuu⟧⟦{講座|こうざ}→講座：09790_kouza⟧ (short-term intensive course)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長期間|ちょうきかん}→長期間：25696_choukikan⟧: long period of time — the opposite
- ⟦{短期|たんき}→短期：04050_tanki⟧: short-term — more compact form, often used as a modifier
